ideas.children_en: Esau was called Edom because of his red color and red lentil stew. He had several wives from different families, and they all had children in Canaan.

ideas.children_he: עֵשָׂו וְיַעֲקֹב חָיוּ בִּמְקוֹמוֹת שׁוֹנִים כִּי הָיוּ לָהֶם עֲדָרִים רַבִּים.
ideas.children_en: Esau took his family and moved to another land because of Jacob. Both had large flocks and lived far from each other. Esau lived in Mount Seir. His descendants were called Edomites.

ideas.children_he: מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ שֶׁל עֵשָׂו הָפְכָה לְעַם אֱדוֹם.
ideas.children_en: Esau lived in Mount Seir and had children both in Canaan and outside. They formed a big family with names of tribes and peoples.

ideas.children_he: לְכָל מִשְׁפָּחָה גְּדוֹלָה הָיוּ מַנְהִיגִים מִשֶּׁלָּהּ.
ideas.children_en: The leaders of Esau's families, called chiefs, led different clans. Each was a head of a tribe.

ideas.children_he: בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם חָיוּ גַּם מִשְׁפָּחוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת.
ideas.children_en: In Esau's time, there were local rulers in Edom. Some families lived there from early times.

ideas.children_he: הַתּוֹרָה מַזְכִּירָה שֵׁמוֹת שֶׁל אֲנָשִׁים וּמִשְׁפָּחוֹת מִן הֶעָבָר.
ideas.children_en: The children of Ana and families of Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan are mentioned. Ahalibama was also Esau's wife.

ideas.children_he: הָאֲנָשִׁים שֶׁחָיוּ בְּשֵׂעִיר הִקִּימוּ קְבוּצוֹת וְהָיוּ לָהֶם מַנְהִיגִים.
ideas.children_en: The leaders of the Horites from Seir are named. They were chiefs in Edom.

ideas.children_he: גַּם לְעַמִּים שְׁכֵנִים הָיְתָה הִיסְטוֹרְיָה שֶׁל מְלָכִים.
ideas.children_en: When Edomites were independent, Jacob's sons were in exile and couldn't rule them. The verse may point to Moses as their first leader.

ideas.children_he: מֶלֶךְ אֶחָד הִתְחַלֵּף בְּמֶלֶךְ אַחֵר, וְהַשִּׁלְטוֹן הִשְׁתַּנָּה.
ideas.children_en: The first king of Edom was Bela son of Beor from Dinhabah, followed by Jobab from Bozrah. They were not from the same dynasty.

ideas.children_he: הַתּוֹרָה מְסַפֶּרֶת עַל מְלָכִים וּמִלְחָמוֹת שֶׁהָיוּ בֶּעָבָר.
ideas.children_en: After Jobab, there was King Husham from the Temanites, then Hadad king who defeated Midian. His city was Avith.

ideas.children_he: הַשִּׁלְטוֹן בְּאֱדוֹם עָבַר בֵּין מְלָכִים שׁוֹנִים.
ideas.children_en: Leaders after Hadad were Samlah, Shaul, Baalhanan, and Hadar. Hadar's wife had a strong background which might have helped his rule.

ideas.children_he: לְכָל אֵזוֹר הָיוּ מַנְהִיגִים שֶׁנִּזְכְּרוּ בַּסִּפּוּר.
ideas.children_en: Names of Edom chiefs from different regions are listed. Some names appeared before, some were new.
